state.title: TypeError when checking out with an empty cart
state.body: Steps: add an item, remove it, click checkout. TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'total') at cart.js:142. Reproduced on staging with a fresh account, v2.3.1.

note: clear defect with steps and error text

state.title: API returns 500 for uploads larger than 10 MB
state.body: curl -F file=@big.zip https://api.example.test/v1/uploads returns HTTP 500; gateway log shows unhandled PayloadTooLarge in handlers/upload.py:88. Files under 10 MB work. Gateway v1.14.0, reproduced on two accounts.

state.title: Dark mode toggle resets after page reload
state.body: Switch to dark mode, reload, theme is light again. The localStorage key 'theme' is never written; ThemeProvider only saves on mount (src/theme/Provider.tsx:31). Chrome 126 and Firefox 127 both affected.

state.title: Pagination skips page 3 when filtering by label
state.body: GET /issues?label=infra&page=3 returns page 1 results; the same query without the label works. The Link header points to page 5 after page 2. Started after the query-builder refactor in v0.9.0. Full request/response JSON captured.

state.title: Background worker leaks about 50 MB per hour
state.body: Worker RSS grows from 120 MB to 2.1 GB over 40 hours; heap snapshot shows accumulating Buffer objects in the job runner. Restarting clears it. Worker v3.2.0 on Linux, graphs and snapshots attached, reproducible with the ops queue-load script.

state.title: Invoice PDF shows '$' instead of the euro sign for EUR accounts
state.body: Any invoice for an account with currency=EUR renders $1.234,00. The template currency.pdf.erb hardcodes the dollar glyph at line 12; the locale files do contain the euro sign. Reproduced in staging with test account invoice 8341.

state.title: Login redirect loop when the session expires mid-checkout
state.body: Let a session expire, add an item to the cart, complete checkout: the browser bounces between /login and /checkout forever with auth=true piling up in the URL. HAR file included. Auth middleware v4.0.2, Chrome 126 and Safari 17.

state.title: Webhook deliveries arrive twice for the same event
state.body: Since Tuesday every payment.succeeded event arrives twice within 200 ms with the same delivery id in both payloads (events evt_1021, evt_1022 in our logs). We are not idempotent and double-charge test customers. Queue logs show two workers picking up the same job.

state.title: CLI crashes with IndexError when the config file is missing
state.body: Fresh machine without ~/.toolrc: running 'tool status' raises IndexError in config.py:57 (argv misindexed when the defaults path is absent). Full traceback included. Tool 0.4.2, Ubuntu 24.04.

state.title: CSV export mangles non-ASCII names
state.body: Exporting a project containing the name Jose Garcia with accents produces mojibake. Round-trip confirms double encoding: the exporter writes UTF-8 without a BOM while the importer assumes latin-1 (exporters/csv.py:23). Version 1.9.0, sample files attached.

state.title: Dev-machine requests get rate limited after five calls
state.body: The rate limiter buckets everything under the gateway IP when X-Forwarded-For is missing, so local development hits 429 after five calls (config limiter.key=ip). Expected: fall back to the API key before the socket IP. Reproduced with the cookbook snippet, gateway v2.1.0.

state.title: Date picker shows the wrong day for UTC-05:00 users
state.body: Selecting 2026-03-10 stores 2026-03-09T19:00:00-05:00 and the list renders Mar 9. The picker converts local midnight to UTC with toISOString() and drops the zone (DatePicker.tsx:77). Repro steps and a screen recording attached, timezone America/New_York.
